title: The Gram operator A*A of an injective linear map is invertible
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ and every continuous linear map A : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ (ℝ^d := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) that is injective, the Gram operator G := A* ∘ A : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ (A* = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A, the Hilbert adjoint) is a unit of the ring ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝⁿ, whose multiplication is composition; i.e. G has a two-sided inverse that is a continuous linear map.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), Function.Injective A → IsUnit (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A)
